import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

index = 0
t = int(data[index])
index += 1

results = []

for _ in range(t):
    n = int(data[index])
    index += 1
    q = list(map(int, data[index:index + n]))
    index += n
    
    min_p = []
    max_p = []
    
    current_max = 0
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        if q[i] > current_max:
            current_max = q[i]
            min_p.append(current_max)
            max_p.append(current_max)
        else:
            min_p.append(q[i])
            max_p.insert(0, q[i])
    
    results.append(" ".join(map(str, min_p[::-1])))
    results.append(" ".join(map(str, max_p)))

print("\n".join(results))
